topics.title: Start with the example
topics.summary: Inspect the recorded scope summary, then explore the hardware bench.

sections.title: Workflow
paragraphs: The example contains recorded summary measurements, not raw captures or bundled firmware. Device models and wiring references remain available without connecting hardware.

topics.title: Your hardware
topics.summary: Use the 2D plan and 3D bench to inspect devices, pins and signal paths.

sections.title: Acquisition
paragraphs: Configure your own capture adapter and transport. Reforge includes no remote account, SSH key or private machine binding. Unknown readings remain unknown; disconnected instruments do not generate signals.

cards.title: Import a waveform
cards.description: Parse CSV, TSV or supported saved traces

topics.title: Diagnostics and schemas
topics.summary: Inspect native errors, client failures and app state locally.

sections.title: Local inspection
paragraphs: Tools → Diagnostics shows local failures and exports a metadata-only report. Developer builds can enable the native inspector and WebKit developer tools. The agent inspector is disabled in normal builds.
